verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component with no items, records, or user interface on which to run bulk operations. Bulk actions are a software or SaaS capability, so this story is a category error for a processor. The marketing lines about multitasking ('play, stream, and edit, all at once') and editing photo libraries describe third-party apps running on the chip, not a bulk-operations feature of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
